feeds.title: Crazy Egg Blog
feeds.description: Covers hard-boiled conversion rate optimization advice from the experts at Crazy Egg to see what's hot and what's not, and to know what your web visitors are doing with tools, such as heatmaps, recordings, A/B testing and more.

feeds.title: Bryan Eisenberg
feeds.description: Bryan Eisenberg is a CRO Guru, professional keynote speaker and best-selling author.

feeds.title: VWO Blog
feeds.description: VWO is a conversion optimization platform hosting an impressive CRO blog where you can pick up plenty of practical insights backed up by actual data. Case studies and CRO idea lists will be a helpful tool to freshen up or structure your knowledge about CRO.

feeds.title: Conversion Blog
feeds.description: WiderFunnel is a CRO company that has been in the CRO game since 2007. Its blog delves into A/B testing, conversion optimization and other things related to them. Wonderful place to learn something new about testing and CRO process.

feeds.title: Conversion Sciences Blog
feeds.description: Conversion Sciences is another A/B testing conversion optimization agency that has stood the test of time (it was founded in 2007). In this blog you can find some remarkable and noteworthy ideas about A/B testing and conversion optimization.

feeds.title: Targeted Visitors Blog
feeds.description: Explore how Targeted Visitors agency drives engagement and conversions in these informative blog posts. Learn how tailored traffic can elevate your online presence. Targeted Visitors is a trusted website traffic partner helping businesses, large and small, reach their business goals since 1999.

feeds.title: OptinMonster Blog
feeds.description: OptiMonster is a cute green email pigging monster, sorry, we mean it is a customer acquisition and lead generation platform. The OptiMonster blog is a real deal. It filled with practical insights on email marketing, content marketing, and, of course, conversion optimization.

feeds.title: Instapage Blog
feeds.description: The Instapage blog is the ultimate resource for landing page best practices to help you maximize your lead generation and online marketing efforts. Instapage turns your ad clicks into conversions by providing an end-to-end solution for building, personalizing, & optimizing post-click experiences at scale.

feeds.title: Convert Blog
feeds.description: The Convert Experiences blog has a great mix of current news, information, and useful guides. The topics covered are varied, including transparency & privacy, technical writeups, best practices, and industry roundups, all while staying relevant to marketers and optimizers of all skill levels. Convert Experiences is a low-stress personalization tool for enterprises that want more from their CRO budget.

feeds.title: SiteTuners
feeds.description: Site Tuners are pioneers of conversion optimization who established their company in 2002 (yes, 14 years ago, when all the dinosaur CRO companies were still amoebas). Here you will find a lot of useful stuff about all aspects of conversion optimization, podcasts and case studies.

feeds.title: Hum Commerce » Knowledge Center
feeds.description: Read the news, tips and tricks, best practices on conversion rate optimization of your online business. Learn from the experts at HumCommerce today!

feeds.title: Quanticate Blog
feeds.description: We aim to provide information and support written by our experienced staff. We want to share our knowledge and create an archive of information that you will be able to engage with, share and comment on. Quanticate is one of the world's largest global data-focused Clinical Research organizations (CRO) also known as a 'Biometric CRO'. We are primarily focused on data capture, statistical analysis, and clinical trial reporting.

feeds.title: GuessTheTest | Your digital marketing resource for CRO, A/B Testing, and UX strategy
feeds.description: Your digital marketing resource for Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO), A/B testing, and UX strategy. Take your best guess on this week's test and win.

feeds.title: GetUplift Blog
feeds.description: Talia Wolf is a Conversion optimization specialist, trainer & speaker. Learn how to grow your business with meaningful conversion optimization, persuasive design and emotions.

feeds.title: Marketing Experiments
feeds.description: MarketingExperiments is the internet based research lab and a part of MECLABS Institute. Do you want to know how best CRO practices actually work? The Marketing Experiments Blog has the largest collection of experiments in optimizing marketing and sales processes.

feeds.title: Conversion Fanatics Blog
feeds.description: Conversion Fanatics is a full service conversion rate optimization company that helps shopify and other e-commerce businesses improve their conversions through strategic conversion optimization strategies. Read the latest tips and tricks on ppc advertising, conversion optimization, marketing improvement and e-commerce hacks so you can improve your results.

feeds.title: Convertize Blog
feeds.description: Convertize is a web consulting agency specialised in Conversion rate optimization. CRO Experts deliver tips and practical knowledge about AB Testing, Conversion rate optimization (CRO) and Consumer Behaviour.

feeds.title: CXL Blog
feeds.description: In-depth growth & conversion optimization blog for advanced optimizers. At the head of ConversionXL is Peep Laja, a self-professed conversion optimization junkie. He is also the founder of Markitekt, a data-driven agency that helps eCommerce and SaaS companies grow. Get conversion and marketing advice based on scientific research and in-depth industry knowledge.

feeds.title: The Invesp Blog
feeds.description: Another blog from pre-historic CRO times: Invesp was founded in 2006 (yes, we are that old, but cool). Basically, this blog has everything your wish: long and detailed articles, infographics, and guides.

feeds.title: Conversion Rate Experts
feeds.description: Conversion rate experts are one of these CRO dinosaurs who are present in the market since 2006. Their blog is all serious and tends to sound slightly didactic. But if you are able to make your way through client testimonials to actual articles, you will definitely find a couple of CRO gems.

feeds.title: Optimizely Blog
feeds.description: Optimizely is the worlds leading experimentation platform, enabling businesses to deliver continuous experimentation and personalization across websites, mobile apps and connected devices.

feeds.title: Monetate
feeds.description: Monetate is the world's most trusted experience optimization and 1-to-1 personalization platform. Quickly build and run A/B and multivariate tests, easily segment and target, and personalize campaigns to improve the overall customer experience.

feeds.title: Omniconvert Blog
feeds.description: The official blog of Omniconvert.com the all-in-one website optimization platform. They post juicy articles on topics such as optimization and growth for e-commerce, SaaS and B2B companies
